newsitem.title: GERMANY: Cyanide mustard found in German blackmail probe.
newsitem.headline: Cyanide mustard found in German blackmail probe.

text.p: Police probing an attempt to blackmail a German food manufacturer said on Tuesday they had discovered a tube of mustard laced with cyanide in a southern German supermarket.
The Saarbruecken store where the mustard was discovered and two other supermarkets were closed as a precaution, police said. The mustard was made by Thomy, a unit of Switzerland's Nestle SA .
A police spokesman said Thomy had been receiving letters threatening to contaminate its products for several months.

A company spokesman declined to detail the extortionists' demands and would only say they had not asked for money. The company also said it had received an "ominous" letter on Monday, which warned: "This time it's not just Thomy products."
Police appealed to the public not to consume any products bought in the supermarkets in Saarbruecken, Bremen or Regensburg in the first week of April.
